notes.title: TPOF Stability Update
notes.content:
Minor Update to TPOF:
[list]
[*] Renpy has been updated from 7.4 to 8.0, hopefully this will improve performance
[*] Ice and Blood overlay transitions have been simplified [ old code was hacky and unstable ]
[*] Added in persistent saves throughout to prevent players from losing progress if their game closes improperly [ closing a laptop without shutting the game down, losing power, game crashes, etc ]
[/list]

Please let me know on twitter @HumanGatobob if you experience crashing or an error due to this update- the Renpy update required some code fixes <3

notes.title: Free DLC
notes.content:
[h1]The Show Must Go On![/h1]

[h2]To get this free DLC, simply update your game![/h2]

To access the new short linear story, you'll need to do the following:
[list]
[*] Unlock the secret CONTROL achievement. You'll know you've done this when a secret character appears directly on your collections screen.
[*] Start a new game, and right before the auction concludes- Point at the Announcer.
[/list]

[b]Special notes![/b]
[list]
[*] READ! THE! WARNINGS! This DLC is extremely nasty. 
[*] This DLC also responds to the sexual content toggle
[*] This DLC also responds to the 'memelord mode' toggle
[/list]

[b]OTHER NOTES ABOUT THIS UPDATE:[/b]
[list]
[*] Small bug fixes, a few images have updated slightly to better suit the story
[*] The sexual content toggle has been expanded: you can now choose to play with explicit text, but not explicit artwork.
[/list]
